headline: Zelensky confirms US intel sharing resumed after ~3-day blackout
dek: Zelensky: US intel on incoming Russian ballistic missiles was blocked ~3 days ('We didn't see attacks'), then 'de-blocked by the American side. Now it works.' Starshield (militarized Starlink) speed restrictions continue; Zelensky does not know if Trump or Musk ordered them, believes 'both'…
sources: Zelensky on NBC Meet the Press; Kyiv Independent; NY Post
fault_line: Should the US hold back intelligence to pressure Ukraine into stopping refinery strikes — or is that siding with Russia?

sections.what_happened: Zelensky: US intel on incoming Russian ballistic missiles was blocked ~3 days ('We didn't see attacks'), then 'de-blocked by the American side. Now it works.' Starshield (militarized Starlink) speed restrictions continue; Zelensky does not know if Trump or Musk ordered them, believes 'both' involved. Hopes for talks with US on Oct 20-21.
sections.what_verified: Kyiv Independent and NY Post independently quote the same interview; aligns with 1700-scan Starshield reporting
sections.what_disputed: Pause duration (~3 days) is Zelensky's claim only; who ordered restrictions is unknown even to Zelensky (his 'both' belief is speculation — label as such).
sections.why_matters: Trump's squeeze play on Kyiv laid bare: intel switched off for 3 days while ballistic missiles fell. Zelensky calls it a 'historic mistake' to side with Moscow — the US-Ukraine rift deepens as the 1,000-drone strike lands.
sections.context: Background: Russia/Ukraine — NEW in-window: Zelensky confirms US intel sharing resumed after ~3-day blackout

totw_analysis: Our read: Trump's squeeze play on Kyiv laid bare: intel switched off for 3 days while ballistic missiles fell. Zelensky calls it a 'historic mistake' to side with Moscow — the US-Ukraine rift deepens as the 1,000-drone strike lands. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Should the US hold back intelligence to pressure Ukraine into stopping refinery strikes — or is that siding with Russia?
